data.title: 阿尔法 · 烛光长桌上的暗影对弈
data.description: 商会顶层密室内古典长木桌前，阿尔法手持羽毛笔与黑色棋子，在烛台暖光下与暗影对局，目光笃定中带着信赖。
data.location: luxurious executive private chamber with dark oak paneling and heavy drapery
data.action: sitting at mahogany table, fingers lightly holding a carved black chess piece over board, looking up with calm confident smile
data.promptProse: Alpha sits at an antique mahogany chess table under warm candelabra glow, lightly poising a black chess piece as she smiles calmly toward the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Her fingers hold the chess piece steady as candelabra light warms her golden hair.
